title: Record an aesthetic session
summary: The full four-step flow, saved automatically: consent, photos, treatment and closing.

steps.title: Menu → Patients
steps.details: Patient list; tapping one opens their record on the right.

steps.title: Open their record
steps.details: Tap the patient in the list. The guide continues once their record is open.

steps.title: Create
steps.details: Everything that can be created for this patient: clinical, financial and scheduling.

steps.title: Aesthetic session
steps.details: Opens the guided flow of a new session. Nothing is saved until you choose a service.

steps.title: Status and progress
steps.details: The status comes from the data: Draft, Consented, In treatment, Ready to close. Each finished step adds 25%. Next to it you see what is missing and when it was saved: everything saves on its own.

steps.title: Date and doctor
steps.details: Session date (it can't be in the future) and who performs it. From My Workspace they come from the appointment.

steps.title: Today's services
steps.details: Check what is being done today. Only aesthetic services appear; if one is missing, set it up in Sales → Services. "Last session" adds those from the previous time.

steps.title: Sign the consent
steps.details: Appears once a service is chosen: risks explained, photo authorizations, who signs and the signature. Without a signature that service cannot be marked.

steps.title: Sign
steps.details: Signs all pending services at once. What was signed can no longer be changed.

steps.title: Today's photos
steps.details: Step 2. A photo of any view is enough; none is needed if the patient declined photos or if every mark is on the body.

steps.title: Views
steps.details: Front, left and right profile, each with today's photo and the earlier ones.

steps.title: Take photo
steps.details: Opens the camera with a framing guide and, if there is one, the last photo see-through to repeat pose, distance and light.

steps.title: Treatment
steps.details: Step 3. It stays locked until at least one consent is signed.

steps.title: Mark on the map
steps.details: Choose the service below and tap the face or body. Each mark needs a quantity above 0. A separate guide covers all the tools.

steps.title: Closing
steps.details: Step 4: what was applied, the summary, the charge and the next appointment.

steps.title: Close session
steps.details: Enabled once consents, the photo and the marks are complete. After that it stays read-only and only accepts amendments.
